title: Iridescent Desert Mirage
description: A surreal desert landscape features undulating sand dunes in warm beige tones. A winding river of liquid mercury flows through the scene, reflecting iridescent rainbow colors and leading to a large, melting green serpent-like creature in the distance that drips viscous fluid into the metallic stream.
prompt: Surreal desert landscape with rolling sand dunes in warm beige and brown tones. A winding river of reflective liquid mercury flows from foreground to background, displaying strong iridescent rainbow oil slick reflections. In the midground, a large melting green serpent-like creature with dripping viscous fluid rests atop a dune, its form partially dissolving into the metallic stream below. Dreamlike and ethereal atmosphere with smooth painterly textures.
